_help: Manual facts the APIs cannot provide. Keys under 'entries' are lowercase DOIs. Applied at render time (npm run render). Fields: role ('first' | 'co-first'; first authorship is otherwise inferred from author order), note (short badge, e.g. 'In revision'), pdf, code, data, slides (URLs), summary (path to an interactive summary page). 'include' adds DOIs missing from ORCID/PubMed (still verified against Crossref); 'exclude' hides DOIs.
